encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: πένθ᾽ ἡμιμέδιμν᾽, ἐὰν βιάζωμαι. Β. μόλις;
ὡς ὀλιγόσιτος ἦσθ᾽ ἄρ᾽, ὃς κατεσθίεις

note.p: Athenaeus 10, 415 c τοιοῦτός ἐστι καὶ ὁ παρὰ Φερεκράτει ἢ Στράττιδι ἐν Ἀγαθοῖς, περὶ οὗ φησιν· ἐγὼ κτλ. v. 3. 4 etiam 6, 248 c ὀλιγοσίτου δὲ μέμνηται . . . καὶ Φερεκράτης ἢ Στράττις ἐν Ἀγαθοῖς ὡς ὀλιγόσιτος κτλ.

Hercules aliquis loqui videtur. μακρᾶς, quod 'longa triremis' contra 'linguam peccaret', Herwerdenus (Nov. add. crit. 4) cum ἡμέρας coniungebat non animadvertens id multo magis contra linguam peccare. Meinekius (Anal. crit. Ath. 109) μικρᾶς τριήρους, quod ironice vult intellegi. singulis hominibus choenix cottidie sufficiebat; triremi cum ducenti fere veherentur, quattuor medimnis cum hecteo in singulos dies opus erat. cf. Boeckh. Oec. Att.² I 396. Bergk. R. c. Att. 286.

lg.l: ἡμέρας ἐν τοῖς στεφανώμασιν, οἱ δ᾽ ἐν τῷ μύρῳ

note.p: Athenaeus 15, 685 b ἐν τοῖς ἐπιγραφομένοις δὲ Ἀγαθοῖς Φερεκράτης ἢ Στράττις φησί κτλ. λαλεῖτε Dobr. Aristoph. Eccl. p. 196] λαλεῖται. ἐν τοῖς στεφανώμασιν, ἐν τῷ μύρῳ, i. e. in ea fori parte, ubi corollae et unguenta veneunt. cf. Aristoph. Eq. 857. chorus — nam ex eius cantico fragmentum excerptum est — Atheniensium quales tum erant mollitiem et inertiam reprehendere videtur. neque enim adsentior Bergkio R. c. Att. 285. cf. Aristoph. Eq. 1375. Eccl. 303. versus 3 est Εὐριπίδειος τεσσαρεσκαιδεκασύλλαβος altera arsi soluta. Hephaest. 15, 20.
